notes.title: Update 0.6.55 | Fully re-built Steam version for better performance
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33103105/459cfec1f1b6c1628c0f55146d4a8f10b5d96113.png

Hi Everyone,

As per the feedbacks & suggestions received from the community, we have released a new build for the game.

This is a MAJOR update with the following key changes,

Using completely different technology for the Steam Version.
Delivers more than 5x improved rendering performance.
Almost 100MB lesser download size.
Greatly reduced memory usage.
Lighter to use game window.
Steam overlay Support for Windows platforms.
Mac version doesn't support steam overlay as of now
Optional web-flow for in-app purchases
Only if Steam Overlay Support is disabled in the in-game settings
Improved game layout specifically designed for Desktop.
added support for Linux 64-bit


We appreciate your time in giving us your suggestions and feedback about the game and reporting issues encountered. It really helped us a lot to improve the game for you all!

More new features are coming in future updates! Stay Tuned!

Once again, Thank you for playing Downtown Mafia!

notes.title: Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars now on Steam !
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33103105/8685cae5c840bdf0a0c777b50e296e4c3500857f.png

We are proud to release Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars (a.k.a DTM) on steam! Join now and become the biggest gangsta in town.

Roadmap and Future Development
The launch of Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars is just the beginning for us. We still have many features in our development roadmap but rather taking all the decisions ourselves, we want you as a player to be a part of the process. 

Being an indie game devs, we like to be as open as possible with our player community, listen to your feedback, ideas, and suggestions and hence create an awesome gaming experience for all of us!

Use our latest promo code "DTMINCHINA" to claim 100 FREE Diamonds in-game, which you can use to upgrade your arsenal and hire mercs.

We truly hope you’ll have fun playing Downtown Mafia: Gang Wars!

Follow us on Facebook and Steam Community

notes.title: Addictive Text-based Mafia MMO RPG Coming soon to Steam !
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33103105/5c1059c2955c5132660e2a2d991214fea2303248.jpg
After a great success in other platforms with over 1million downloads, Downtown Mafia is making its way to Steam. 

We aim to redefine the way the Text-Based games are played! 

Downtown Mafia is a Text-Based online multiplayer role-playing game (Yeah, you heard it right!) where you team up with other players to build your gang, wage Gang Wars, Turf Wars, Boss Fights, Hire Mercs, Hit-List your enemies. 

Increase your influence and firepower by buying weapons, vehicles, armor and other equipment, completing City-based Missions, TOURNAMENTS and much more...

Coordinate your actions with your fellow mobs or gang with our new chat system where you can communicate in real time.

The fun and opportunities are endless!
